context: Three men — Riku, Ryosuke, Ren — over drinks. Long generation-bridging adult talk.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 皆さん、こうやって、三人で、嬉しい。
lines.en: All of us here together like this — it makes me happy.
lines.style: Warm, open delivery. Voice brightens on the opening, genuine pleasure audible. Slow, deliberate pacing. The contentment of a moment he's been waiting for, settling into each word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さんと、れんお兄ちゃんと、こうやって、ね。
lines.en: With dad and Ren-onii-chan — being here like this.
lines.style: Soft agreement, a little wonder underneath. Not performing emotion but feeling it land. Quiet, steady pace. The vulnerability of admitting something matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 三世代、こうやって、お話できるの、本当に、ありがたい。
lines.en: Three generations talking together like this — I'm truly grateful for it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. Opens gently. Pause before 「ありがたい」, letting the weight of gratitude settle. Warm but measured — the sincerity of someone who doesn't overstate.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: リクも、立派な、社会人になって。
lines.en: Riku has grown into such a fine adult.
lines.style: Pride and tenderness intertwined. Light emphasis on 「立派」 — not boasting, observing. Warm undertone of emotion held in check. Father's quiet admiration, audible but not loud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、れんお兄ちゃんに、いつも、見守ってもらって、本当に、感謝してる。
lines.en: Dad, Ren-onii-chan — you've always been watching over me. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Direct, unguarded sincerity. Voice steadies as he names what matters. No hesitation, but not performative either. The careful gratitude of someone not used to saying these things aloud.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 俺も、亮介さんから、ずっと、教わってる。
lines.en: I'm always learning from you, Ryosuke-san.
lines.style: Humble, genuine. Slight self-conscious edge on the formal address — respect without distance. Warm but grounded. The honesty of someone still finding his footing.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 皆さんが、いてくれるから、私も、しっかり、生きてこれた。
lines.en: Because you're all here, I've been able to live firmly, to keep going.
lines.style: Philosophical turn. Breath deepens slightly. Slower pacing — he's trusting this moment to land. Quiet recognition that this matters. Not sentimental, but deeply felt.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さんが、ずっと、お父さんで、本当に、よかった。
lines.en: Dad being dad all this time — that's been really good.
lines.style: Simple statement, enormous weight behind it. Voice softens on 「お父さん」. No elaboration needed. The kind of love that doesn't need explanation, just acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: これからも、ずっと、皆で、ね。
lines.en: From now on too — always together like this.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Opens warmly, settles into a gentle promise. Small smile audible in the voice. Forward-looking but grounded in this moment.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 将来、孫の代まで、こうやって、繋がっていけたら。
lines.en: If we could stay connected like this, all the way down to our grandchildren's generation…
lines.style: Wistful, philosophical. Pacing slows. He's imagining something precious. Warm throughout but tinged with the poignancy of mortality — not sadness, just the weight of inheritance.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 絶対、繋いでいく。家族で。
lines.en: We definitely will. We'll keep the bond going. As a family.
lines.style: Firm resolve underneath warmth. «絶対» carries conviction without hardness. Steady eye-contact level in the voice. Promise made calmly, deeply — the son stepping into his role.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 乾杯しましょう。家族の絆に。
lines.en: Let's make a toast. To family bonds.
lines.style: Rallying tone, the gathering moment crystallized. Lifts slightly, draws everyone in. Warm but purposeful — the ceremonial quality of marking something sacred together.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Bright, full, celebratory. Opens with real energy — the release of emotion into joy. Voice carries the collective warmth of the moment up and outward.
